name: manual_0c6631
claim: Do not make an input card mandatory for a flow whose output is the card: the outer dry run produces the receipt the card is built from, so a required input card breaks the real flow. Keep cycles usable without a card, have a cycle that validated a card record its card_id, and enforce 'no card, no promotion' at promotion time: a reviewed or graduated card needs a receipt with card_checked true and its own card_id.
